Containers.Name: TowerTorch
Containers.Overview:
Your server's UI on fire. Your disks stay cool.
TowerTorch gives your whole Unraid server a fully revamped, modern interface, without replacing a single page. Dashboard, Main, Shares, Docker, Plugins, VMs and Settings get one clean, consistent look: tiles or lists, cards with switches instead of checkboxes, small animated pictures for the disks, the array and the mover, one accent colour or a rainbow, light and dark. Everything stays where Unraid put it, so nothing you know moves.
Underneath, it looks after your containers: a start plan starts each one only once the container it depends on is actually ready, not just running, with per-container CPU, RAM and bandwidth limits, a watchdog, schedules and an idle stop on top. A master switch turns all theming off and keeps only the orchestration.
